_comment: TRAINABLE dataset on REAL Pegasus connectivity. data_pegasus.json exists to measure headroom and deliberately fixes one variant, one chain strength and an eight-candidate bank, so it cannot train a bank selector and offers no embedding variation for an encoder to exploit. This config restores the axes the learned comparison needs -- two field/coupling variants, three chain strengths, a 64-candidate bank -- while keeping the hardware growth route, so a model can be trained and evaluated at 10-14 physical qubits on vendor connectivity rather than on synthetic quotient graphs. Still not a calibrated device: no working-graph exclusions, no per-qubit calibration, no noise. teacher.mode=none is forced above 10 qubits.
